summary: VCI Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing two private subscription agreements with its Chairman/CEO, who purchased 1,200,000 shares at $0.75/share on May 20 and 654,135 shares at $1.33/share on May 26, 2026, for total proceeds of $1.77M. The transactions closed immediately, increasing his stake from ~7.6% to ~33.1%. Shares are restricted under Rule 144 with no warrants or derivatives. The proceeds support working capital. This is an insider capital raise, not a special situation.
